title: DDI Study With Multiple-dose LX4211 and Single Dose Rosuvastatin

sections.abstract: This study will be conducted as a single-center, open-label, 2-period, single-sequence, drug-drug interaction study to assess the effects of multiple-dose LX4211 400 mg (2 × 200-mg tablets qd × 7 days) on the PK of single-dose rosuvastatin (1 × 10-mg tablet) in healthy male and female subjects.
